name: verikit-local
description: Local-development marketplace for the VeriKit Claude Code plugin (HarmonyOS Kit selection). Add by absolute path (e.g. /plugin marketplace add /abs/path/to/packages/verikit-claude-code-plugin) then /plugin install verikit@verikit-local. Build it first with `npm run build` so dist/ + skills/ are populated.

plugins.name: verikit
